product_family: Basecamp 5 is a cloud project management and team collaboration platform. The 37signals suite also includes HEY (email), Fizzy, Backpack, and Highrise. Basecamp is AI agent-ready with integration support for Claude, ChatGPT, and other LLM tools via CLI and API.

certifications.name: SOC 2
certifications.proof_quote: 37signals does not hold SOC 2 certification. The company philosophy accepts that 'Basecamp doesn't have SOC 2 compliance that enterprise security teams require,' viewing cert pursuit as 'compliance theatre' rather than essential.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of ISO 27001 certification on security or compliance pages. Not listed among certifications or compliance standards claimed by vendor.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: GDPR compliant with Data Processing Agreement: 'We establish GDPR-compliant data processing agreements with each subprocessor.' Standard Contractual Clauses implemented for EU data transfers.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Basecamp does not offer a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) at any plan tier. No HIPAA certification. Users should not upload protected health information.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Card information is transmitted, stored, and processed securely on a PCI-Compliant network.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 (Cloud).
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27017 certification on vendor domain.

certifications.name: ISO 27018 (PII in Cloud)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27018 certification on vendor domain.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of FedRAMP certification or compliance.

privacy.ai_training_note: Basecamp lists Anthropic and OpenAI as subprocessors for 'AI assistant services.' These are integration points where users can opt-in to use external AI tools. No evidence that Basecamp itself trains ML models on customer project data. Customers control whether they share data with these third parties via optional API/agent integrations.
privacy.data_region: US (default); EU data residency available as optional feature for GDPR-compliant European storage

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: TLS/HTTPS with modern cipher suites (AES_128_CBC, SHA2, ECDHE_RSA) and forward-secrecy key exchange

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: AES-256 encryption for stored files; Basecamp 5 includes app-level 'at-work' encryption where database content fields are encrypted with individual keys

security.name: Access Controls
security.value: Audited employee access to customer data; limited access only for support, error fixes, security investigations, and legal compliance

security.name: Infrastructure
security.value: Redundant data centers with automatic failover; firewalls and 24/7 monitoring; regular encrypted backups

security.name: Security Testing
security.value: Third-party security audits and bug bounty program

security.name: Uptime & Reliability
security.value: 99.99% historical uptime record; current status shows 100% uptime for Basecamp 5 (past 90 days); no SLAs offered

security.name: Data Portability
security.value: Users can export and take their data at any time; cancel anytime with no lock-in

products.name: Basecamp 5
products.data_scope: Projects, tasks, messages, files, documents, calendar events, comments, chat, recordings (voicenotes)
products.notes: Main product. AI agent-ready with API, CLI, and Skills. Supports integration with Claude, ChatGPT, and other LLMs. Pricing: Free (1 project, 20 users), Pro ($15/user/month), Pro Unlimited ($299/month).

products.name: HEY
products.notes: Separate product by 37signals. Email service with focus on inbox organization and spam filtering.

products.name: Fizzy
products.data_scope: Product data not detailed in public materials
products.notes: Product mentioned on 37signals site; limited public information available.

products.name: Highrise
products.data_scope: Customer contacts, deals, notes, activity history
products.notes: Legacy product; separate subprocessor list maintained.

products.name: Backpack
products.notes: Legacy product; separate subprocessor list maintained.

compare.data_residency: US by default; EU data residency available (GDPR-compliant)

flags: Basecamp intentionally does not pursue SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certifications, viewing them as 'compliance theatre.' This is a deliberate company choice but may disqualify Basecamp for enterprises with strict compliance mandates.
Basecamp does not offer a BAA and is unsuitable for healthcare data. Users must not upload PHI.
37signals explicitly does not offer service-level agreements, though uptime history is strong (99.99%).

Basecamp lists Anthropic and OpenAI as subprocessors for optional 'AI assistant services.' Customers should review Anthropic and OpenAI's own terms before enabling agent integrations, as external AI vendors may process project data.
Data protection certification is limited to GDPR/DPA. No other data protection certifications (ISO 27701, etc.) are mentioned.
